shifts.summary: Overall the shift was rated Moderate by most sources. Candidates reported attempting between 17 and 89 questions well. Reasoning and English were generally found easy, while Quant varied from easy to hard. General Awareness difficulty ranged from Easy to Moderate, with some reports calling it Difficult.

sections.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
sections.notes: Reasoning described as easy or simple, some time‑consuming similar options, statement‑based and blood‑relation items common.

sections.name: General Awareness
sections.notes: GS described as moderate overall, some found it difficult or out of syllabus; topics covered history, art, economics, current affairs, polity, geography and specific indexes.

sections.name: Quantitative Aptitude
sections.notes: Quant ranged from easy‑to‑moderate to hard; many arithmetic and mensuration items, some advanced topics like statistics and probability, considered the toughest part by several candidates.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: English reported as easy overall; cloze tests were straightforward, passages long and time‑tight for some, grammar and vocabulary items varied in difficulty.

intro: The SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 9 October 2026 comprised three shifts. Shift 1 was generally rated Moderate, with candidates attempting between 17 and 89 questions successfully. Shift 2 showed a range from Easy to Moderate, and the reported average good attempts were 85.6. Shift 3’s analysis is currently partial and will be completed after the shift concludes. All figures are unofficial and SSC normalises scores across shifts.

faqs.q: What was the overall difficulty level of the SSC CGL Tier 1 exam on 9 October 2026?
faqs.a: The exam difficulty varied by shift: Shift 1 was rated Moderate, Shift 2 ranged from Easy to Moderate, and Shift 3 was reported as Difficult.

faqs.q: How many questions did candidates attempt successfully on 9 October 2026?
faqs.a: For Shift 1, candidates reported attempting between 17 and 89 questions well. Shift 2 had an average of 85.6 good attempts, while Shift 3 reported 80 good attempts, though its full analysis is pending.

faqs.q: Which sections were considered easy or difficult on 9 October 2026?
faqs.a: On Shift 1, Reasoning and English were generally easy, while Quantitative difficulty varied. Shift 2 had easy English, moderate Reasoning, and mixed Quant difficulty. Shift 3 showed easy General Awareness and English, but difficult Quantitative aptitude.

faqs.q: Why is the analysis for Shift 3 on 9 October 2026 incomplete?
faqs.a: Shift 3 is currently marked as 'partial'; the full analysis will be added after the shift data is fully compiled.

faqs.q: Are the reported figures for the 9 October 2026 exam official?
faqs.a: No, the figures presented are unofficial. SSC normalises scores across shifts, so the final official results may differ.
